snippet.query: What is white-label connectivity for MSPs?
snippet.exactText: White-label connectivity for MSPs lets a managed service provider offer branded mobile, IoT, broadband or voice services using an upstream provider’s infrastructure. The MSP still needs a defined operating model for quoting, customer access, support, billing and exit. A branded portal alone does not establish those responsibilities or guarantee a particular margin.
